project_type: Next.js 14 App Router multi-tenant WhatsApp Business SaaS (TypeScript)
build_system: Next.js 14 (next build); Prisma client generated via prisma generate. Build script is `prisma generate && next build`.
test_framework: NONE. There is no jest/vitest/playwright config and no `test` script in package.json. Verification is the production build plus reasoning/manual checks. Do NOT invent a test framework for this task.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` (= prisma generate && next build) after each feature; it must complete with no type errors. The Turso migration script is run with `node scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs` (no npm script exists for scripts/*.mjs); it must create the TenantMetaApp table on first run and be a clean no-op on a second run. If TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN are not available in the environment, state that and verify the DDL + idempotency by code review instead. Reason through the design's error-handling and precedence tables for the resolver and webhook rather than relying on automated tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma generate regenerates node_modules/.prisma client from prisma/schema.prisma; it runs automatically as part of `npm run build`. No checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Migration scripts under scripts/*.mjs parse .env manually and connect to live Turso via @libsql/client because `prisma db push` is rejected over libsql:// (P1012). Running the migration requires a live .env with TURSO_DATABASE_URL + TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN. Never run `prisma db push`. ENCRYPTION_KEY (base64 32 bytes) must be present for encrypt/decrypt round-trips.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in repo. Global rule: keep scratchpad.md at repo root current with every change affecting features/endpoints/schema/config. Secrets (app secret, access token) are stored only as AES-256-GCM ciphertext via src/lib/crypto.ts and must never be returned by an API, rendered in UI, or logged.
key_patterns: API routes: `getServerSession(authOptions)` guard (401 if no session.user.id), zod safeParse with `parsed.error.flatten()` in a 400 `details` field, NextResponse.json, top-level try/catch → 500 { error: 'Internal server error' }. Secret serialization: serializeNumber (src/lib/whatsapp.ts) strips accessToken from responses — mirror this for the Meta app secret. Prisma client: default export `prisma` from @/lib/db (libSQL adapter). Crypto: encrypt()/decrypt() from @/lib/crypto; decrypt throws on bad key/tampered ciphertext and must be caught without leaking the secret. Graph API base: https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0. Prisma datasource provider is `sqlite`. Migration script pattern: scripts/add-meta-onboarding-columns.mjs (manual .env regex parse, createClient, PRAGMA table_info, try/catch → process.exit(1), client.close() in finally).
